# Living.Fit

> > Living.Fit is a fitness marketplace and training platform offering home gym equipment from brands like PowerBlock, BC Strength, and Homegrown Lifting, plus 50+ workout programs and a workout generator app.

The platform combines e-commerce for strength training equipment (barbells, dumbbells, resistance bands, kettlebells) with digital workout programs designed by certified trainers like Aaron Guyett, CSCS. Available on iOS and Android with free trial access.
